record.paper_title: SYMMETRY AND COLORINGS: SOME RESULTS AND OPEN PROBLEMS
record.original_question: Is there a connected compact group G and an integer r for which ms(G, r) < 1/r², where ms(G, r) is the largest ε such that every measurable r-coloring of G contains a measurable monochromatic symmetric subset of Haar measure at least ε? In particular, what is the exact value of ms(SO(3), 2)?

evidence.quote: for every such a group G and every r ∈ N let ms(G, r) be the least upper bound of ε > 0 such that for every measurable r-coloring of the group G there exists a measurable monochromatic symmetric subset A ⊂ G of measure µ(A) ≥ ε.
5.4. Question ( [5]). Is there a connected compact group G with ms(G, r) < 1 / r2 for some r ∈ N? In particular, what is ms(SO(3), 2) equal to?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a connected compact topological group equipped with its normalized Haar measure μ. A subset A ⊆ G is called symmetric if there exists g ∈ G such that A = gA⁻¹g, i.e., A is invariant under the involution x ↦ gx⁻¹g for some g ∈ G (equivalently, symmetric about the point g in the sense of the group involution). Given r ∈ ℕ, a measurable r-coloring of G is a partition G = C₁ ⊔ … ⊔ Cᵣ into μ-measurable sets. Define

  ms(G, r) := sup { ε > 0 : for every measurable r-coloring of G there exists a measurable monochromatic symmetric subset A ⊆ Cᵢ (for some i) with μ(A) ≥ ε }.

Question 1: Does there exist a connected compact group G and an integer r ≥ 1 such that ms(G, r) < 1/r²?

Question 2: Determine the exact value of ms(SO(3), 2), where SO(3) is the group of rotations of ℝ³ with its Haar probability measure.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the line of work of Banakh, Verbitsky, and Vorobets on Ramsey-type theorems for symmetric subsets of compact groups. Available literature (the Banakh–Verbitsky–Vorobets paper in the Electronic Journal of Combinatorics, and subsequent surveys including the 2009 problems list) presents this as an unresolved question, with no published determination of ms(SO(3), 2) or example of a connected compact group violating the 1/r² bound.

status_evidence.title: A Ramsey Treatment of Symmetry
status_evidence.snippet: Defines ms(G,r) and discusses bounds for compact groups; SO(3) case left open.
status_evidence.claim: The framework defining ms(G,r) is established but exact values for SO(3) are not given.

status_evidence.title: Monochrome symmetric subsets of colored groups - ScienceDirect
status_evidence.snippet: Studies monochrome symmetric subsets in colored groups; general 1/r² type bounds discussed.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on ms(G,r) have been obtained, but the specific question for connected compact groups remains posed as open.
